plugin.name: Browser Use
plugin.description: Let the agent drive a real browser: navigate, read pages, fill forms, click and sign in.
view.console.label: Browser Use
view.console.description: Browser runtime status, session tabs and security policy
settings.browserSource.title: Browser source
settings.browserSource.description: managed: use a browser and profile owned by this plugin (recommended). attach: connect to your already-running Chrome with remote debugging enabled and inherit all of its sign-in state; in this mode you own the browser and the plugin no longer manages windows.
settings.headed.title: Show browser window
settings.headed.description: Turn off to run headless. Keep it on when you need to handle sign-in or captchas yourself.
settings.allowedDomains.title: Domain allowlist
settings.allowedDomains.description: Empty means no restriction. When set, the agent may only navigate to these domains; everything else is blocked. Supports example.com and *.example.com, separated by commas or newlines. Remember to include CDN domains a site depends on, or pages will render incompletely.
settings.denyEval.title: Block page script execution (eval)
settings.denyEval.description: Stops the agent from running arbitrary JavaScript in the page. This is the single most important defense against prompt injection from page content; keep it on.
settings.denyUpload.title: Block file uploads
settings.denyUpload.description: Stops the agent from uploading local files to a page.
settings.denyDownload.title: Block file downloads
settings.denyDownload.description: Stops the agent from downloading files from a page.
settings.toolsProfile.title: Tool set
settings.toolsProfile.description: Which browser tools are exposed to the model. Defaults to core (navigation, snapshots, interaction). Combine network, state, debug, tabs, react, mobile with commas, or use all. More tools cost more context.
settings.maxOutput.title: Max output per call (characters)
settings.maxOutput.description: Truncates page snapshots and text reads so a huge page cannot flood the model context.
console.title: Browser Use
console.installHint: First use requires installing the browser automation runtime (~90MB). If no Chrome is installed, Chrome for Testing is downloaded as well.
console.outdatedHint: Found agent-browser {{found}}, but this plugin needs {{required}} or newer. Upgrade installs the pinned version into Vetta's own runtime directory and leaves your existing global install untouched.
console.chromeFound: System Chrome detected; it will be reused, no extra download needed.
console.chromeMissing: No system Chrome detected; Chrome for Testing will be downloaded during install.
console.sessions.title: Sessions and tabs
console.credentials.title: Sign-in state and credentials
console.credentials.hint: Credentials are encrypted locally; passwords never enter the model context.
console.credentials.clearProfileHint: Clears every cookie and sign-in session in the plugin-owned browser profile.
console.policy.title: Security policy
console.policy.attachWarning: Attach mode is on: the agent shares your browser instance, so it can reach any site you are signed into.
console.log.title: Activity log
console.log.empty: No browser activity in this session yet.
